meta.secretsPolicy: names and locations only; values redacted

01_runtime.note: Confirms whether the repository scripts were parsed by 5.1 or 7.

02_liveHub.note: Existence of .remember recorded while listing its parent. Nothing inside was listed, read, counted or hashed.

03_tools.note: Two discovery methods per tool: Get-Command and where.exe. All resolutions recorded so shadowing and multiple installs are visible.

04_path.note: Effective PATH is the merged process view. User and Machine are read separately so a scope conflict is visible and a fix can name the scope.

05_runtimeConfig.note: Presence, size and modified time only. No file contents emitted. MCP server names only, never commands, arguments, environment or tokens. Presence is NOT evidence that a runtime loads the file.

06_codexStalePaths.note: Matched path fragments only, with line numbers. No surrounding content. Nothing modified.

unverified: Presence of a configuration file is not evidence that a runtime discovered, loaded, or enforced it. Activation requires a fresh-session test.
design-systems\.remember: existence only. Nothing inside was listed, read, counted or hashed.
Reparse points were excluded before the directory/file split. Nothing behind them is inventoried.
File contents were not emitted. Only paths, sizes, modified times and SHA256 hashes.
Inventory is exhaustive only within the physical tree, excluding pruned directories and reparse-point targets.
